verdict.rationale: Google Cloud IAM lets you control who can do what on which resource, with fine-grained permissions. Workload Identity Federation gives workloads access through federated identities instead of long-lived service account keys. Together these support least-privilege credentials that an agent workload could use. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and scoping a service account or short-lived token for an agent, any agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
